What would close the remaining gaps?

Footage: render the production pack with licensed realistic characters; inspect contact and continuity; validate pixel tracking against withheld coordinates.

Broadcast validation: independently annotate unfamiliar licensed match clips, including moving cameras, occlusion and different kits. Freeze the detector before testing; report misses and false events.

Commentary: ask 3–5 people who did not build the system to complete all eight cases. Return exported ratings to the organizer. Independence must be checked outside this anonymous page.
